site_notes.cn_horinger_cloud_valley: No regulatory IT MW matched to these provisional halls after searches of sthjt.nmg.gov.cn and fgw.nmg.gov.cn. Huawei south-area substation EIA is a separate location; its transformer MVA is not IT MW. https://sthjt.nmg.gov.cn/xxgk/sthjzdlyxxgk/wrfzhssxg/hyfshjjg/202502/t20250210_2664372.html
site_notes.helingeer_hub: Provincial EPB/NDRC search found Huawei south-area power infrastructure, not a load or parcel attributable to this hub centroid. https://sthjt.nmg.gov.cn/xxgk/sthjzdlyxxgk/wrfzhssxg/hyfshjjg/202502/t20250210_2664372.html
site_notes.cn_ulanqab_park: No regulatory IT MW matched to this provisional park after searches of sthjt.nmg.gov.cn and fgw.nmg.gov.cn. VNET line-terminal coordinates are about 15 km away, near the separate Epoch VNET location. https://sthjt.nmg.gov.cn/wrfz2021/fsgl_8115/hyfshjjg_8116/202501/t20250110_2651491.html
site_notes.ulanqab_hub: VNET 110 kV supply-line EIA gives a project location, not hub-wide IT load or a campus boundary. Provincial EPB/NDRC search; see data/china_project_documents.json. https://sthjt.nmg.gov.cn/wrfz2021/fsgl_8115/hyfshjjg_8116/202501/t20250110_2651491.html
site_notes.cn_zhangbei_alibaba: No attributable regulatory IT MW found after searches of hbepb.hebei.gov.cn and hbdrc.hebei.gov.cn for Alibaba, Yunlian, Miaotan and Xiaoertai. MIIT case study is not an energy-review filing; underlying phase-two approval not retrieved. https://gxt.hebei.gov.cn/sme/zx/gzdt9/2025042122120672072/index.html
site_notes.zhangbei_hub: No filed load matched to the hub centroid after provincial EPB/NDRC searches. Yunlian phase-two approval remains a retrieval lead, not imported capacity. https://gxt.hebei.gov.cn/sme/zx/gzdt9/2025042122120672072/index.html
site_notes.zhongwei_hub: Provincial EPB/NDRC search found Zhongjin Xuanhe supply-project EIA and grid approvals; no parcel/load matched to the generic hub centroid. https://sthjt.nx.gov.cn/zwgk/hjpj_63348/hjyxpjsl/202605/t20260509_5235732.html
site_notes.guian_hub: Provincial EPB/NDRC search found Huawei AZ3/A4 substation EIA leads. PDFs not fully inspected or matched to a campus parcel; no figures imported. https://sthj.guizhou.gov.cn/zwgk/zdlyxx/fsjg/fslxmspqgs/202503/P020250321602011794355.pdf
site_notes.qingyang_hub: No attributable campus filing figure found in indexed searches of sthj.gansu.gov.cn and fzgg.gansu.gov.cn. This is a bounded negative search, not proof that no filing exists; see docs/china_project_search.md.
site_notes.chongqing_hub: Provincial EPB/NDRC search found Benmao and GDS energy reviews; named project parcels not matched to this hub centroid. Planned annual electricity is not measured current IT load. https://fzggw.cq.gov.cn/zwgk/zfxxgkml/sphzbaxx/202406/t20240606_13270491_wap.html
